A '''battle''' at [[Basilisk]] occurred during the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. At [[Basilisk]], the two sides fought with the Republic emerging as the victors. Sometime following the battle at Basilisk, the Republic used the planet as a launching point for a [[Battle of the Chazwa system (Jedi Civil War)|campaign]] to take [[Chazwa/Legends|Chazwa]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Basilisk makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" /> An exact date is not provided for the battle, and it only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.<ref name="EA" />
